name: agentory-channels
description: Open-source IM channel adapters for Agentory — ChannelAdapter contract + official reference implementations + mock + contract test suite

scripts.build: npm run build -w @agentoryhq/im-channel-contract && npm run build -w @agentoryhq/im-channel-mock && npm run build -w @agentoryhq/im-channel-feishu
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/mock/dist/index.test.js packages/feishu/dist/index.test.js
